_comment: ai_ops hooks template. Before installation replace <ai-ops-root> and <workspace-root> with absolute paths; relative hook paths are not valid when the host changes cwd. Copy content into .claude/settings.local.json at workspace root. PreToolUse contains the owner-applied blocking workspace guard. The fallback is POSIX-shell/Bash syntax and must run under Bash; if Python or a hook path is unavailable, it emits the deny response on stderr and exits 2. The dynamic PostToolUse npx Markdown hook is intentionally disabled pending an integrity-controlled local replacement.

hooks.command: python -I "<ai-ops-root>/00_Admin/scripts/hooks/guard_workspace_writes.py" --workspace-root "<workspace-root>" --config "<ai-ops-root>/00_Admin/configs/workspace_containment.yaml" --config-sha256 20FEC564D881482683509BEE4B7BE3948DABBA38343453C2979A4E67ED8F0D5B || { printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"cause=workspace guard unavailable; owner=workspace owner; next=restore Python and the configured ai_ops hook"}}' >&2; exit 2; }
